# defectdojo_note_type (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo note type, which classifies the notes on findings, tests and engagements. Managing note types needs a superuser or the note type configuration permissions.

~> **Deleting a note type deletes every note of the type.** The provider refuses to destroy a note type that has notes unless `force_destroy` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_note_type" "code_review" {
  name         = "Code Review"
  description  = "Notes from a manual code review."
  is_mandatory = false
}

# An active mandatory note type: the UI asks for a sign-off note before a
# finding is closed, or set inactive or false positive.
resource "defectdojo_note_type" "sign_off" {
  name        = "Sign-off"
  description = "Who accepted closing the finding, and why."
  is_single   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The description of the note type. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `name` (String) The name of the note type, unique across all note types, compared case-sensitively. At most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Optional

- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to destroy the note type even when it has notes, which DefectDojo then deletes too. Defaults to `false`.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the type is offered for new notes. Defaults to `true`, as in DefectDojo.
- `is_mandatory` (Boolean) Whether, while the type is active, the UI keeps users from closing a finding, or setting it inactive or false positive, until the finding has a note of the type. The API doesn't check it. Defaults to `true`, as in DefectDojo.
- `is_single` (Boolean) Whether an object can have only one note of the type. Defaults to `false`, as in DefectDojo.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the note type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_note_type.example
  identity = {
    id = 3
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the note type

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Note types are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_note_type.example <id>
```
